finalText:
**Real cause found:** `refresh.js:15`, not `tokens.js:6`.

The trace's top frame is a symptom. `auth.internal` returns 400 `invalid_grant` when the refresh token is revoked. In `refreshToken` ([refresh.js:14-16](src/auth/refresh.js:14)), `invalid_grant` isn't in `RECOVERABLE`, so it deliberately returns `undefined` instead of throwing.

That `undefined` flows back through `resumeSession` ([session.js:7-8](src/session.js:7)) straight into `decode(token)`, which crashes on `token.split('.')` at `tokens.js:6`.

So the throw site is just where the missing error handling finally surfaces. Look at `refresh.js:9-19`: it treats "not recoverable" as "swallow and return nothing" rather than surfacing an auth failure the caller can act on.
